verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents a hosted MCP server at mcp.agentmail.to that exposes inbox, message, thread, draft and attachment tools to any compatible client, and offers skills for Claude Code, Codex and others. It also provides an API, OpenAPI spec, SDKs and a CLI. Read, triage, draft and send are each covered by first-party docs: full-text thread search, labels for conversation state, drafts with human review, and sending messages. missing for 10: evidence it connects an agent to a user's existing personal mailbox (e.g. Gmail/Outlook) rather than AgentMail-hosted inboxes, explicit ChatGPT connector documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent email workflow.
